newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan-China trade up 7.2 pct yr/yr in Jan-March.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan-China trade up 7.2 pct yr/yr in Jan-March.

text.p: Taiwan's trade with rival China grew 7.2 percent to US$5.187 billion in the first three months of 1997 compared to the same 1996 period, the cabinet's Board of Foreign Trade said on Tuesday.
Taiwan's exports to the communist mainland rose an annual five percent in January-March to $4.337 billion, while imports rose 20.1 percent to $850 million, a board statement said.
The board attributed the stable export growth to China's improved exports in the first quarter, increasing its demand for Taiwanese materials.
